title: Diagnose the Compound AI System
brief: You get nine wrong answers from the uncurated Meridian agent, one per problem planted
in the dataset. For each, say WHICH STAGE FAILED and WHICH INPUT WAS MISSING.
For example: 'summed a daily snapshot, because no join cardinality was declared', or
'returned nothing for California, because there is no entity matching on state'.
Diagnosis only. You fix nothing today.
Then compare your answers against the sheet you wrote in Lab 0. The gap between what
you noticed then and what you can name now is the exercise.

checks.name: Prerequisite: the uncurated agent exists
checks.hint: Run notebook 08_agents. It carries all 14 base objects, which is the point.

review: Each diagnosis names a stage AND a missing input, not just a wrong answer.
The daily-snapshot failure is identified as a grain problem, not an arithmetic one.
The empty California result is traced to value matching, not to missing data.
The learner compared against their Lab 0 sheet and said what they had missed.

inputs.title: Nine recorded answers from an uncurated agent. Every one is wrong.
rows: These nine were RECORDED from an uncurated agent. They are a case file, not a
prediction — ask your own agent the same questions and you will find it handles
some of them correctly now.
That is not a flaw in the exercise. It is the exercise. The model improves; your
data does not improve on its own, and the failures that survive are the ones
that were never the model's fault.
For each: which stage failed, and which input was missing?
Q: "What do we manage?"
A: $65,398,441,073,204   (sixty-five trillion)
SELECT sum(market_value_local) FROM fct_aum_snapshot
Q: "What was our AUM at the end of last year?"
WHERE snapshot_date = '2025-12-31'
Q: "How did our California advisors do last quarter?"
A: No results found.
WHERE state = 'California'
Q: "What were net sales in FY2026 Q3?"
A: Gross sales $4,882,110,400 and redemptions $4,113,905,220.
CASE WHEN flow_type IN ('SUBSCRIPTION','EXCHANGE_IN') THEN ...
Q: "Show me the allocation by asset class."
A: Two runs, two different tables. One showed FIXED_INCOME at 31%,
the other showed POOLED_VEHICLE at 22% and no fixed income line.
Q: "What is our AUM?"
sum(market_value_local + held_away_value_local)
Q: "What was our return last year?"
SELECT avg(benchmark_return) FROM fct_performance

Q: "What were total flows in March?"
A: $1,904,224,880  — counted on trade_date, including PENDING and
